rationale: Adds a compact final-stage export-budget search that greedily upgrades the most distortion-prone late tail tensors to fp16 only when the exact int8+zlib artifact stays within the 16,000,000-byte cap. This builds on the current recurrent-tail baseline, targets the real scored path directly, and keeps training/validation behavior unchanged aside from the final quantization-aligned endgame.
title: Adaptive Tail FP16 Export Rescue
